cases.provenance: Fictional task-queue regression with an immutable source snapshot and a documented complete tenant query.

request.title: Use one newest-task page for enqueue admission
request.description: An asset-pack task for tenant-a may be queued only when that tenant has no unfinished asset-pack task. Other tenants and completed tasks do not affect admission. The caller holds the tenant admission lock through this check and enqueue.

expectedDefects.invariant: A running asset-pack task for tenant-a must prevent another enqueue even if ten newer canceled tasks for tenant-b fill the first unfiltered page. The target task at position eleven remains unfinished.

evidence.description: newest(10) returns only the ten most recent tasks across all tenants and states. Ten newer done/canceled tenant-b tasks can hide an older running tenant-a asset-pack task before the filter checks it.

cases.provenance: Fictional correction that uses the complete tenant-scoped unfinished query rather than a larger global page.
